messages:
maria (partner-ops): Quick sync request - vendor asked for a mini-sprint to lock H100/H200 + MI300 timelines and marketplace SKUs. Can we do a 20m check today?
kevin (eng-plat): Sure. Are we covering firmware or just image QA?
olivia (solutions): Both. SI teams need a golden image; also want a final perf smoke (kv-cache + end-to-end).
lina (pm): Priorities: marketplace tags, SI image cut, press embargo. Aim to announce early next week if we can.
maria (partner-ops): Proposed: cut candidate images Wed AM, QA Wed PM, marketplace tags Thu AM, announce Fri. Thoughts?
sam (partner-eng): Heads-up: vendor may push H200 firmware Wed night (0.9.7). If that happens we should gate the image. Can we do conditional tagging?
kevin (eng-plat): Yes. We'll tag candidate-v1 and then golden-v1 after firmware confirmation. Automate rebuild: ./build_image.sh --gpu=h200,h100,mi300 --tag=candidate-v1
maria (partner-ops): Lina, please own marketplace naming convention so marketing/legal align (e.g. redwood-gpu-h200-2026-04-candidate).
lina (pm): On it. I'll add SKU mapping and ping legal for embargo clearance.
olivia (solutions): SI teams - reserve Wed PM 2h for smoke signoff. I'll post test matrix (P50/P95, throughput, model load).
vendor-bot: :mega: Vendor scheduled firmware 0.9.7 for 2026-04-08T22:00Z (ETA 2h).
sam (partner-eng): If patch lands on time we keep flow; if delayed we slide 24h. I'll add an auto-watch for firmware tag and notify here.
kevin (eng-plat): Devops note - snapshot kernels and add rollback commands in runbook. I'll add snapshot-kernels.sh and image-rebuild.sh --rollback <snapshot>.
maria (partner-ops): Action list: @lina marketplace naming + legal, @olivia test matrix + slide, @kevin runbook + conditional build, @sam firmware watch. Sync 16:00 PT today.
olivia (solutions): Quick Q - include Gaudi in first wave or keep tier-2? Drivers have been flaky.
lina (pm): Defer Gaudi unless vendor confirms driver stability by Tue EOD. We'll prepare tags but mark 'deferred'.
maria (partner-ops): Working doc: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/mini-sprint-announce-window - add blockers.
kevin (eng-plat): Queuing CI now. ETA candidate images Wed 10:30 PT.
olivia (solutions): I will produce a one-slide perf snapshot from smoke tests for marketing Tue EOD if we confirm Fri announce.
vendor-bot: :white_check_mark: Will post a reminder 12h before the announce window.
maria (partner-ops): Thanks team - we'll adjust if firmware patch changes timing. :thumbsup:
